subject: general
question:
Choose the correct word to complete the sentence.

The deer ran swiftly across the open _____.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. plain .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"plain"** refers to a large area of flat land, which is the appropriate context for the given sentence.
 
• Option **"plane"** refers to either a flat surface or an aircraft, which does not fit the sentence.
 
• Option **"plan"** refers to an arrangement or strategy, which is irrelevant here.
 
• Option **"plaid"** refers to a pattern of tartan or checkered fabric, which is also unrelated.

Correct sentence: *The deer ran swiftly across the open **plain**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Word Usage:**
 
 
• **"Plain":** Refers to flat, open land, often used in geographical contexts.
 
• **"Plane":** Can refer to an aircraft or a flat, level surface.
 
• **"Plan":** Indicates a strategy, arrangement, or intention.
 
• **"Plaid":** Refers to a checkered or tartan pattern, usually on fabric.
 
 
 
• It is important to choose the word that best fits the context of the sentence.
